history.summary: Plan r1 committed (397d26b): six phases across Ansible, the provider, HelmCharts and DockerImages, plus 16 acceptance criteria. Checking the chart gate's 'lands green today' against real prd renders turned up two operator calls in plan_questions_r1.md: storage fails helm lint even with its prd values (Q1), and kubeconform -strict rejects homeassistant-mcp's duplicate command key (Q2).

Plan r2 committed (1c7cd34): P4 now runs kubeconform strict, fixes the storage cronjob separator and removes homeassistant-mcp's dead first command line, per the Q1/Q2 rulings. verification.json grows to 18 criteria (V09 rewritten; V10 storage and V11 homeassistant-mcp added; proof criterion names the three HelmCharts redeploys). The dry-run parses six phases.

The plan covers slice.md 1:1 and its load-bearing claims hold, but the binding grounding section still says storage's lint failure needs no fix and misdescribes template, and the round-two ruling insertion misfiled three settled items; one advisory on what the kubeconform container can see.
